job.title: Software Engineer, Ad Signals
job.workplace: 100% remote (offices in NY, SF, LA and Chicago for hybrid/onsite preference)
job.pay_full: $190,800 – $267,100 a year base salary, plus equity (restricted stock units)

details.about: Reddit is a community of communities, with more than 100,000 active communities and about 130 million daily active unique visitors. This team builds the app conversion signals behind Reddit's app advertising business. Reddit is looking for a senior backend software engineer to work on MMP integrations, SKAN processing and App CAPI, making app installs and in-app events more reliable, more useful and easier for advertisers to integrate.
duties: Own backend projects across MMP, SKAN and App CAPI, from requirements and design through implementation, rollout and operation
Build scalable ingestion and processing services with clear contracts, validation, deduplication, failure recovery and data lineage
Develop integration tooling and diagnostics that help advertisers and partners find and fix signal delivery problems
Analyse signal quality and delivery metrics, investigate discrepancies and prioritise improvements with product and data science partners
Evolve schemas and integrations with partner engineering and downstream teams without disrupting existing advertisers
Build privacy and security requirements into system design and keep controls in place across the data lifecycle
Raise engineering quality through testing, design reviews, incident learning and mentorship
needs: Senior-level backend software engineering experience delivering and operating scalable production systems
Hands-on app ads signals or mobile measurement experience, with depth in MMP integrations, SKAN or app conversion APIs
Strong programming, API design, distributed systems and SQL skills, with independent problem solving and data investigation
Clear communication and a record of delivering results with cross-functional teams and stakeholders
details.benefits: Base salary $190,800 – $267,100 a year; final offers depend on skills, experience and credentials, and the posting may span more than one career level. The role is eligible for equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, possibly commission. Benefits include comprehensive healthcare (medical, dental and vision) and income replacement programs, a 401(k) with employer match, family planning support, gender-affirming care, mental health and coaching benefits, flexible vacation and paid volunteer time off, generous paid parental leave, and global benefit programs covering workspace, professional development and caregiving support.
notes: 100% remote within the US; offices in New York, San Francisco, Los Angeles and Chicago for those who prefer hybrid or onsite work
The posting may span more than one career level
In select roles and locations, interviews may be recorded and transcribed, with the option to opt out beforehand
